redfin.remarks: This exceptional Inglewood duplex offers a rare opportunity for both savvy investors and multi-generational buyers, delivered completely vacant at the close of escrow. Situated in a highly desirable neighborhood just 1.5 miles from the world-class SoFi Stadium, this property combines prime real estate positioning with incredible value-add potential. Both detached residences are fully equipped for modern comfort, featuring central heating , air conditioning , new electrical panels and energy-efficient TRIPLE-paned windows throughout. The charming front house welcomes you with a spacious living room and a formal dining room, two comfortable bedrooms, one bathroom, and a dedicated indoor laundry room plus extensive storage. The back house is a bright and airy one-bedroom, one-bathroom sanctuary boasting original hardwood floors. It features an excellent layout centered around an exceptionally large bedroom, with a separate fenced entrance ensuring complete privacy between the two homes. Adding massive upside to this property is the detached two-car garage positioned in the middle of the lot. Already equipped with a full bathroom, this structure presents a seamless opportunity for an ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit) conversion to maximize your rental income. Whether you want to live in one and rent the other, house extended family, or cash-flow three separate units, this versatile Inglewood property is ready to fulfill your vision.
